ios.desc:
MiepMiep is the ultimate mileage tracker for personal and business use. With GPS tracking, Shortcut automations, custom tags, and rules for automatic tag application, you can easily track and organize your mileage. Get automatic notifications to never forget to report a trip, and use the app offline, completely anonymously, and without any monthly fees. Streamline your mileage tracking with MiepMiep today!

MiepMiep is simple to use, with automatic mileage tracking and the ability to start a manual trip in seconds. You can easily export your mileage without limits, and with GPS tracking, you can register your business miles or personal drives with just a start and stop. MiepMiep even provides the start address, distance, route, date, and other data for each trip.

Easy
MiepMiep is simple, mileage tracking should take little time!
The app lets you use automatic mileage tracking and start a manual trip in seconds. Export you’re mileage without limits.
MiepMiep is the simplest and cheapest mileage tracking app out there!

Record trips with GPS
With GPS you can easily register your business miles or personal drives. All you have to do is start and stop the trip. Or make an automation with Shortcuts to automate the mileage tracking. MiepMiep provides the start address, distance, route, date and other data.

Automatic start and stop
With Shortcuts you can automate your mileage tracking, so you will never forget a trip. Trigger a new trip based on CarPlay, NFC or Bluetooth!

Organize Mileage
With tags you can easily recognize or export your drives.
Do you drive different vehicles? No problem!
Whether you drive different vehicles or want to distinguish between business or personal trips, MiepMiep lets you easily add tags. Apply rules to automatically apply tags.
You can use these tags later when exporting.

Never forget to report your trips again. 
Receive a notification if you stand still for too long.

Full control
Forgot to log a trip? You can log any mileage completed in the past by manually adding your trips. Adding, editing or deleting is no problem.

Export
Instantly export all your tracked miles or a selection of your logs to CSV locally on your device.
After that you can do whatever you want with your data. MiepMiep leaves you free in this, your data, your choice!

Anonymously
Many apps require personal data or sharing your mileage. MiepMiep does not do this! Your data is only present on your own device. You do not need to create an account for this. Miep
